bestBets.overview: SWITCH ON looks to have returned a much more mature horse this preparation. Was strong first up as a short priced favourite, hitting the line strongly to get the job done. Will only be fitter for that effort and expect she can continue to progress here. LEGASELLI was a little plain first up but should strip fitter now second up. Drawn ideally in barrier 4 and with some clear running late, expect she can be hitting the line strongly. GRAFOLOGY resumes for his second preparation and showed some nice improvement in his latest trial. Looks to have matured in the paddock and expecting an improved showing this prep. CHAMPAGNE BABY looks capable of being competitive on debut.

raceTips.comment: Grafology sparks interest resuming for a second prep with blinkers on. A recent trial looked promising, he draws well and strikes what looks an even maiden. Switch On was well supported when resuming and was solid despite finding one better. Fitter/further are pluses. Legaselli just held her ground when resuming over a shorter trip. A longer trip looks advantageous. Cool Ledger is hard-fit and will be strong late.
